planes.name: Assignment
planes.question: Who was given this address, and on what authority?

planes.name: Presence
planes.question: Is the address or prefix actually present on the network?

mechanisms.name: IPAM / RIR / CRM baseline
mechanisms.establishes: Intended prefixes, pools, assignments, owners and purposes.
mechanisms.unlocks: The intended side of every comparison.

mechanisms.name: DHCP lease events
mechanisms.establishes: Which client held which address, and when, inside DHCP-managed pools.
mechanisms.unlocks: Lease history, pool pressure and assignment-conflict evidence.

mechanisms.name: CMTS bindings
mechanisms.establishes: Cable modem to CPE address bindings on DOCSIS-served space.

mechanisms.name: RADIUS / Diameter accounting
mechanisms.establishes: Session start and stop records binding an address to a subscriber session.
mechanisms.unlocks: Session-level attribution for PPPoE and mobile address pools.

mechanisms.name: CGNAT logs
mechanisms.unlocks: Attribution of shared public addresses to inside subscribers.

mechanisms.name: BMP routing state
mechanisms.establishes: Prefixes present in the operator's own routing tables.

mechanisms.name: ARP / ND caches
mechanisms.establishes: On-link hosts seen by gateways, IPv4 by ARP and IPv6 by Neighbor Discovery.
mechanisms.unlocks: Presence evidence for static assignments that never use DHCP.

mechanisms.name: External BGP + RPKI
mechanisms.establishes: How prefixes appear on the public internet and whether ROAs authorize their origin.
mechanisms.unlocks: External-visibility and origin-validation checks for announced space.

mechanisms.name: Active probing
mechanisms.establishes: Whether an address answers an authorized, scheduled probe.
mechanisms.unlocks: Liveness confirmation before an inactivity candidate goes to review.

mechanisms.name: IPDR usage
mechanisms.establishes: Per-subscriber usage volumes from cable access equipment.
mechanisms.unlocks: Usage-based inactivity evidence for DOCSIS subscribers.

mechanisms.name: Flow export
mechanisms.establishes: Sampled traffic flows per address (NetFlow, IPFIX or sFlow).
mechanisms.unlocks: Traffic-based activity evidence for zombie-candidate review.

mechanisms.name: DNS resolver logs
mechanisms.establishes: Resolver queries originating from each address.
mechanisms.unlocks: An activity signal for addresses with no lease or flow evidence.

functions.name: Scoped intended inventory, prefix planning and metadata-gap review
Pool pressure and oversized-pool review from lease history
Ghost scopes, assignment conflicts and pool-assignment discrepancies
Missing expected routes against intended route policy
Zombie candidates: announced space with no lease overlap

limitations: The populated inputs are local inventory, DHCP and routing demo records; external operator feeds are not connected.
Not connected means no data from that mechanism reaches any calculation. No telemetry does not prove no usage.
Freshness and completeness are per source and scope at the seeded demo clock; declared authority does not prove live system authority.
Function status reports source presence only. Per-scope freshness and completeness still decide whether each finding is healthy, anomalous or unknown.
Source rows whose saved batch also covers another domain are omitted here, as they are from saved-import detail.
